reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a flashing emergency siren or beacon. It fits tasks centered on physical alarms (smoke detectors, home security systems), emergency preparedness, and technical incident/alert management, though it must not be misused merely to mark an unrelated task as 'urgent' (a property) or for morning wake-up alarms (alarm clock).
